presale.l1: Pro is available at the early price of ¥980/mo until the Pro plan reaches 100 members.
presale.l2: Once the Pro plan reaches 100 members, new Pro subscriptions are charged the regular price of ¥2,200/mo.
presale.l3: If you subscribe at the early price, you keep ¥980/mo for as long as your subscription continues. Re-subscribing after cancelling, or changing plans, moves you to the regular price.
